description: Send a request for a free consultation with the site's psychologist. Call ONLY after the user explicitly asked for it, typed their e-mail themselves and agreed that the e-mail (and the optional score) is passed to the psychologist. Never invent or infer an e-mail. Offer it, do not push it.

consent.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to share their e-mail with the psychologist

email.description: E-mail the user provided for the psychologist to contact

score.description: Total score, only if the user agreed to share it

test.description: phq9 = depression (9 questions), sas = smartphone addiction (33 questions)

name: request_consultation
